title: 第1034章 天魂珠第1033章 御灵三杰和噬灵飞蚁
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
神兽？
这只是神话传说中的存在。
在此之前，大家对神兽的实力，都根本没有具体的认识。
而现在呢，这一群天贵城的金丹老祖，终于感受到神兽天龟分身的恐怖实力。
进攻？
金丹期修士的进攻，对于神兽天龟分身来说，普通挠痒痒。
防御？
只是神兽天龟分身的最基础法术攻击，金丹期修士都根本无法抵抗。
这下，大家对神兽天龟分身的实力，有一个非常直观的认识。
这还只是一个分身而已，如果是真正的神兽天龟，可以想象一下，整个人界还不直接毁灭？
怪不得，远古开天辟地之后，神兽都没有在这个界面存在，而是飞升上界。
且说，许雯秋正在说出自己的想法，必须有人去吸引神兽天龟分身的注意力。
这，明显是一个苦差事。
并且，危险性极大。
在场的，都是一些老油条，怎么可能会接下这种几乎是必死的任务。
所有金丹老祖的目光，都有一些闪躲。
包括，一直以来，都是一副大义凛然模样的将军。
也难怪，这位将军此刻狼狈不已，身上原本威风凛凛的铠甲，早已经破烂不堪。
哪里还有往日的高傲模样。
总之，所有金丹老祖都保持沉默，没有一个主动站出来。

“咦？李供奉呢？”
这时候，一向细心的许雯秋，终于发现问题。
李凡，竟然不见了！
许雯秋四下打量，却根本不见李凡一丁点的影子。
什么情况？
刚才还明明在距离许雯秋不远的地方。
怎么一转眼的功夫，人就凭空消失了？
一定是李供奉会什么隐身之术。
隐身术，在修仙界，一直是最稀少，最罕见的功法。
而李凡这种神不知鬼不觉的隐身术，那更是极其少见的。
“你说的是谁，对啊，刀疤脸呢？”
城主小姑娘，也早已经看穿李凡的易容。
小姑娘很快反应过来，是李凡已经不见踪影。
其他的金丹老祖可不管李凡的消失，趁这个空隙的时间，都各自疗伤，并且为下一次的斗法，做最后的努力。
而灵气墙上的飞蚁，也在疯狂啃食上面的灵气。
很明显，御灵三杰正在用秘术，加快飞蚁啃食灵气墙的速度。
只有大家脱困，才有可能对抗神兽天龟分身的攻击。
content_en:
Divine beast?
This only exists in myths and legends.
Before this, no one had any specific understanding of the strength of the mythical beast.
But now, this group of Jindan ancestors from Tiangui City finally feel the terrifying power of the clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle.
attack?
The attack of the golden elixir stage monks is just an itch for the clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle.
defense?
Even the golden elixir stage monks could not resist the most basic spell attack of the divine beast Sky Turtle clone.
Now, everyone has a very intuitive understanding of the strength of the divine beast Sky Turtle clone.
This is just a clone. If it is the real divine beast Sky Turtle, can you imagine that the entire human world will not be directly destroyed?
No wonder, after the creation of the world in ancient times, the mythical beasts did not exist in this interface, but ascended to the upper world.
Besides, Xu Wenqiu was speaking out her thoughts, and someone had to attract the attention of the clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle.
This is obviously a chore.
Moreover, it is extremely dangerous.
The people present were all veterans, how could they accept such a mission that was almost certain to lead to death?
The gazes of all the Jindan ancestors dodge somewhat.
Including, he has always been a general with a righteous appearance.
It's no wonder that the general is in a state of embarrassment at the moment, and the originally majestic armor on his body is already in tatters.
The arrogance of the past is nowhere to be seen.
In short, all the Jindan ancestors remained silent, and no one took the initiative to stand up.
"Eh? Where is Li Chongfeng?"
At this time, Xu Wenqiu, who has always been careful, finally discovered the problem.
Li Fan is missing!
Xu Wenqiu looked around, but there was no trace of Li Fan at all.
What's going on?
It was clearly not far from Xu Wenqiu just now.
Why did the person disappear out of thin air in the blink of an eye?
Li Gongfeng must have some invisibility skills.
Invisibility has always been the rarest and rarest skill in the world of immortality.
And Li Fan's invisible invisibility technique is extremely rare.
"Who are you talking about, right, where is Scarface?"
The little girl of the city lord has already seen through Li Fan's disguise.
The little girl quickly realized that Li Fan had disappeared.
Regardless of Li Fan's disappearance, the other Jindan Patriarchs took advantage of this gap to heal their injuries and make final efforts for the next battle.
The flying ants on the aura wall are also eating the aura on it crazily.
It was obvious that the three masters of Yuling were using secret techniques to speed up the speed at which the flying ants ate the aura wall.
Only when everyone is out of trouble can they fight against the attack of the divine beast Sky Turtle's clone.
